subject.title: Feature: config-level default task notify policy

question: Should OpenClaw add a public task notify default under agent defaults, and should that surface be global or per-runtime?
rationale: The source proves the missing behavior, but adding a new config/default contract affects channel message volume and upgrade expectations, so automation should not choose the permanent public shape.

options.title: Add per-runtime task defaults
options.body: Add a config surface such as `agents.defaults.tasks.notifyPolicy.{acp,subagent,flow}` with current defaults preserved when unset and explicit per-task values winning.

options.title: Add one global default
options.body: Expose one simpler default for deliverable tasks, accepting the risk that ACP, subagent, and flow behavior may be harder to tune independently.

options.title: Keep only targeted runtime fixes
options.body: Decline the broad config surface and handle Discord, Codex, or ACP noise through narrower runtime-specific issues.

recommendation.title: Add per-runtime task defaults
recommendation.body: Add a config surface such as `agents.defaults.tasks.notifyPolicy.{acp,subagent,flow}` with current defaults preserved when unset and explicit per-task values winning.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal is the task delivery policy extraction plus ACP/subagent routing work on the affected paths.
